HagiCode

HagiCode is an agentic coding workspace. OpenSpec workflows plan the change, multi-agent execution carries it out, and Hero Dungeon makes the long run visible, so ideas become shipped software.

Turn ideas into polished, usable software with a smarter, faster, and more enjoyable agentic coding workflow.

  • FunHero Dungeon turns long coding sessions into a visible, collaborative adventure with heroes, progress, and achievements.
